title: fusion.implementer-request/v1
description: Frozen at plan step 15 on Prior's answer 69 at a4f463f: the code-implementer's immutable role input, the profile's input_schema, composed for the implement step of workflows/repair.v1.json and frozen by the host through host.role.compose.v1 before the attempt's first role call. The module's task carries brief, write_paths, checks, workspace and attempt and nothing else; the host adds project_context and output_contract and refuses a task that already carries a field of either name (67.2), validates the composed object against this schema and answers the frozen bytes, which travel unchanged as RoleCall.input on every role call of the run. The implementer works in the isolated host workspace the workspace step provisioned, detached at base_revision, through host file tools confined to write_paths. Its process grant is the constrained process.check capability (model-facing process_check) for the frozen named checks only (69.6 (4)): it chooses a check by name and never argv, image, mounts, credentials or network; a qualified container runs the exact approved command without network under resource and time limits, with no local shell fallback; and host.capture.v1 runs every check again on the captured tree whatever the implementer ran. No $schema keyword: the host compiles every bundle schema as draft 2020-12 and this file must carry no URL.

brief.description: Module's task: the request's summary and criteria, the paths the explorer read, and the explorer's settled result (W4 of 261010-1504-span-map-and-repair-correspondence.md, Prior's embedded brief composition E7).

exploration.description: The explore step's result, valid against schemas/explorer-result.v1.json; typed loosely here so that this schema never restates that one.

write_paths.description: Module's task: the bound write scope, the request's write_paths unchanged.

checks.description: Module's task: the request's checks unchanged, under the request's bound (every check mandatory, none expected to fail). name is what the implementer passes to process_check and names in each verification entry; argv is the host-provided command display text, echoed in a verification entry's command and never parsed to obtain authority, since the host runs the approved command itself.

workspace.description: Module's task, from the workspace step's answer: the isolated workspace this attempt writes in.

root.description: The host-selected label of the isolated workspace, the only tree the implementer's file tools reach; it is not a path the module submits to acquire authority, and files_changed of the result is stated under it.

attempt.description: Module's task: which attempt this is and, after a revise verdict, the review that asked for it.

previous_review.description: null on attempt 0; otherwise the previous attempt's review-response, valid against schemas/review-response.v1.json, typed loosely here.

output_contract.description: Host-added: the parsed object of the profile's result_schema asset, schemas/implementer-result.v1.json. The host validates the role's answer against that same object.

project_context.description: Host-added: the project instruction files the host selected, root AGENTS.md falling back to CLAUDE.md, empty when neither exists. A reference to CLAUDE.md in the role's neutral text means these entries.
